title: viola × multifida
intro: Viola × multifida, commonly known as the hybrid viola, is a unique flowering plant resulting from the cross between two different species of violas. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Viola × multifida include its use as an antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent, which may help in soothing skin irritations and promoting tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its use in traditional medicine.
